description: Picture-based piece palette: replaces the word labels on palette tiles (Ramp, Curve, Funnel, Hole) with runtime snapshots of the actual piece models, so pre-readers can choose pieces visually (product principle: No reading required). Snapshots are rendered once at startup from the already-loaded Kenney GLB templates into small in-memory images — no new assets, dependencies, or precache entries; text remains only as aria-label and as a fallback if a snapshot fails. The color-cup tile keeps its candy dot and tap-to-cycle behavior; drag, rejection shake, onboarding pulses, layouts, physics, audio, levels, and saves are unchanged.
